## What's Changed
### 🛡️ Security
* [GHSA-m5vj-8mcw-82qx](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-m5vj-8mcw-82qx) (high): `web_fetch_tool` and the `WebFetch` capability's local fallback re-indented a JSON response on the event loop before applying the returned-content limit, so a deeply nested document within the download size limit could expand to hundreds of times its size, using large amounts of memory and delaying other work in the same process. You are affected if an attacker can choose or influence the URLs the tool fetches. Provider-native web fetching is not affected. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`).
* [GHSA-mfx5-pc32-32m8](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-mfx5-pc32-32m8) (high): The `private_key` pattern in Pydantic AI Harness's secret redaction backtracked exponentially on crafted text, so a few hundred characters that begin like a private key could occupy the event loop for minutes or longer. You are affected if you use `redact_secrets` or `secret_data()` with t
